messages:
Maya (CS): Post-call notes from ClarityHealth finance sync. They're escalating: main asks are export fidelity for audits and a per-route billing breakdown. Sharing verbatim asks + suggested mitigations.
Maya (CS): Customer asks (verbatim snippets):
- "We need per-route line items in CSV so our reconciler can map charges to internal buckets."
- "Export CSV must include user_id/session_tag and a stable export_id for audit trails."
- "When long templates are used, generation cuts off mid-sentence. This breaks our clinical notes."
- "Reranker seems to shuffle results for Spanish locale. Order consistency is important."
jenna (CS): Adding context: finance refused to sign the MSA until they can reconcile first-month billing. Renewal discussion next week.
Ethan (PM): Thanks. Let's label by customer impact and suggested short-term mitigation:
- Billing CSV (P0) -> short-term: manual export with route IDs + support help; long-term: console per-route column + filtering.
- Export metadata (P1) -> add user_id/session_tag fields to CSV schema.
- Template truncation (P1) -> investigate seq-length handling; potential temp workaround to truncate prompts client-side.
- Spanish reranker (P2) -> add locale regression test and collect failing queries.
Noah (ProdEng): Quick check: the CSV schema lives in repo infra/tools/exporter. Adding metadata is low-risk. I can open a PR to include user_id and export_id.
Noah (ProdEng): For template truncation, we have two knobs: model max_seq and prompt chunking. I'll run a small repro with their longest template (they shared a sample) and report.
Maya (CS): I'll attach the customer's sample template + the finance reconciliation CSV they sent. Also capturing the exact quote for executive review.
feedback-bot: Created tasks: RW-4601 (add-export-metadata), RW-4602 (console-per-route-columns), RW-4603 (template-seq-investigation), RW-4604 (reranker-lang-regression). Linked to workspace "ClarityHealth-Pilot" and flagged RW-4602 as P0.
jenna (CS): Short-term unblock ask: can we provide a one-off reconciled CSV for their finance team today? They'll accept a manual dump with per-route totals.
Noah (ProdEng): I can generate a manual dump from the staging exports and add per-route aggregation. Need a green light to access the export sample. ETA 3 hours.
Ethan (PM): Approve access. Maya, please send the export sample + permission. Also, let's commit RW-4602 to the sprint if we can get engineering estimate in the next 24h.
Maya (CS): Sharing files now and pinging sales for MSA context. I'll also add renewal risk tag to the account and update the CS dashboard.
Noah (ProdEng): Uploaded a quick repro & initial PR for RW-4601. PR link in the issue. If the manual dump looks right, we can ship the CSV today.
Ethan (PM): Good. Plan for tomorrow's triage: review PRs, confirm manual export delivered, and decide whether RW-4602 gets scope for next sprint. Thanks team.
Maya (CS): I'll follow up with the customer after the manual dump and loop in AM. :white_check_mark:
